oracle.algorithm: Process mirror groups, propagate known letters, reject conflicting fixed mirrors. Remove present letters from the required alphabet. If missing letters outnumber fully unknown groups, return IMPOSSIBLE. Otherwise put ascending missing letters in the last free groups and a in all earlier free groups.
oracle.center: An odd-length center is exactly one mirror group, never two capacity units.
oracle.uniquenessReason: Lexicographic order is determined by groups in increasing left index. Extra groups can be a, while each missing letter needs one group. Moving a larger missing letter left when a later free group is available worsens the prefix; the necessary distinct letters belong in ascending order at the rightmost free groups.
oracle.independentBrute: Enumerate every full-string substitution for every legal template over k=1..3, length=1..6; filter literal palindromes with exact alphabet coverage and minimize complete strings. Also 300 fixed-seed random small templates with k<=5 and at most 5 unknown positions.
oracle.additionalReference: Unit tests use separate per-group candidate lookahead with suffix feasibility, checked against literal enumeration and used for every generated pair and imported pair, including full size.
